summary: Iteration 3: verified Clerk removal and new custom cookie-session admin auth end to end (backend pytest 38/38 + Playwright UI). Checked that Clerk is gone (/sign-in and /sign-up show the site 404, /api/clerk/config is 404, no Clerk scripts or markup). Checked login (wrong password shows an error, correct one opens the dashboard, email is case-insensitive), cookie flags, /auth/me, logout (cookie and server session invalidated), session expiry (API 401 plus UI redirect with the expired message), lockout (6th attempt returns 429), 401 on all 19 protected routes without a cookie, staff 403 and assigned-only scoping, disable and reset-password revoking sessions, staff change-password (old password rejected afterwards, other sessions revoked), and all admin features (stats, search/filter, drawer status/assign to Administrator/notes/history, CSV download, services hide/reorder/edit dialog reverted, content save, Staff & Access add/role/reset). Public site regression passed: home, about, team, partner profile, services selection with WhatsApp, contact form submitted for real, booking form submitted with the POST mocked to save one owner email. Main admin password not changed. All TEST_ data cleaned.

minor.issue: _client_ip trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls (the lockout test itself depends on this). An attacker can rotate X-Forwarded-For to get past the 5-attempt lockout and brute-force the admin password. Fix: use the right-most or ingress-appended hop, and/or add a per-email lockout that ignores IP.
Lockout counter read-then-write is not atomic: parallel bad attempts can all read count<5. Use $inc with upsert.

ui_bugs.issue: Any 401 sends the user to /admin/login with state.expired=true. A first-time visitor who has never logged in, or a user who just pressed Log Out and opens /admin again, sees 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.' Only show this message when a session actually existed (e.g. AdminShell's initial /auth/me should redirect without expired:true).

issues: Preferred date uses the browser's native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover

action_items: Harden the client IP for the login lockout: do not trust a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For[0]; consider a per-account lockout as well
Make the lockout increment atomic ($inc upsert)
Only show the 'session expired' message when a session really expired, not on a first visit or after logout
Optional: use the shadcn Calendar for the booking date
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 745 lines, over the 700-line guideline: split auth/users/enquiries into routers

_admin_hash(): once the admin changes their password, db.meta.admin_credentials permanently overrides ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH from env. Rotating the env hash later has no effect unless that meta doc is deleted. Document this or add a version check

The preview ingress rewrites Set-Cookie to SameSite=None; Partitioned (the backend correctly sends SameSite=strict, checked directly). Expected in production, but CSRF protection relies on SameSite only: there is no CSRF token and CORS allow_credentials is used with configurable origins

Staff users stay visible in /admin/assignees after demotion to disabled (filtered by role, OK). Revocation on role change only happens for 'disabled'; admin->staff demotion takes effect per request since the role is re-read, OK
Legacy Clerk test suites (test_adroit_api.py, test_iteration2_additions.py) no longer work; they are now skipped at module level

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_custom_auth.py -n 0`. It must be serial because of shared STATE, and each run creates 1 TEST_ enquiry, which emails the owner. conftest reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME via dotenv_values and does not print them. The Playwright runtime has no pymongo: for UI session-expiry tests, start a detached watcher with `(setsid nohup python script.py > log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)` that expires admin sessions created after its start time. The booking date is a native date input, so use fill('YYYY-MM-DD').
rca of the issue: SameSite=None seen on the public URL comes from the Emergent preview ingress rewriting Set-Cookie; localhost:8001 returns SameSite=strict. Not an app bug.
